operational_eligibility: Conditional on actual C08 payload/support/attachment rating, source scheduling and mixed-traffic reservations. Geometry routes do not create jobs, operators, inventory or KPI.
yaw_convention: Positive about +Y: 0 faces +Z, pi/2 faces +X. Node yaw wraps to[0,2pi); each edge stores continuous unwrapped yaw. Preserve yaw on reverse edges; never derive it from root-path tangent.

geometry_evaluation.rear_steer_arc: yaw(u)=lerp(start_yaw,end_yaw,u); F=ICR+[-q*cos(yaw),q*sin(yaw)] where q=icr_vehicle_local_x; root=F-.4*[sin(yaw),cos(yaw)]. Exact analytic curves, not chords between samples.
geometry_evaluation.root: Root XYZ is floor centre, as L05. Front axle lies .4m along local+Z.
geometry_evaluation.rear_steering: For positive yaw curvature, virtual rear steer is negative. Reverse edges retain physical steering angle while motion/yaw traversal reverse.
geometry_evaluation.arc_samples: 5degree display/reference samples are not linear interpolation instructions; verification uses<=0.5degree steps plus inter-sample displacement inflation.

A port service action additionally reserves its service group and accepted worker pool. Pedestrian conflicts require shared source scheduling before operations; no independent duplicate vehicle per edge/port.
